PAIRWISE_TRANSITIVITY_FALSE.defect: RedundancyBook.add required only consecutive provider pairs (A-B, B-C for providers A/B/C), so an unverified A-C pair could ride to INDEPENDENT_REDUNDANCY; independence is not transitive
PAIRWISE_TRANSITIVITY_FALSE.remedy: complete unordered pair coverage with exact set equality at the decision point

FIRST_PAIR_BINDING_ASSUMPTION.defect: RedundancyAssessment._binding_matches bound every binding against provider_refs[0]/[1] only, so a legitimate B-C binding in a 3-provider assessment could not be represented
FIRST_PAIR_BINDING_ASSUMPTION.remedy: matcher proves in-set distinct provider pair, subject, and function; no first-pair assumption

UNTYPED_BINDING_CRASH.defect: raw dict bindings injected via model_copy crashed RedundancyBook.add with AttributeError (R2 fail-closed fix had covered only the HARD_RUNTIME gate)
UNTYPED_BINDING_CRASH.remedy: typed-binding gate refuses untyped payloads closed at the decision point

invariant.gate: bound_pairs == required_pairs (exact set equality), re-derived at RedundancyBook.add from the record's current state
invariant.pair_normalization: normalized_provider_pair: (A, B) and (B, A) are one pair; provider ordering cannot change independence truth
invariant.transitivity: NOT_INFERRED — A⊥B and B⊥C does not imply A⊥C
invariant.claim_vs_pair_coverage: claim coverage (bindings exactly cover positive_independence_claim_refs) and provider-pair coverage are separate gates; both must pass; duplicates never substitute for a missing pair
invariant.doctrine_preserved: UNKNOWN/CORRELATED records with declared positive refs are never silently upgraded

verification.pre_r3_book4_tests_preserved: all 137 R1-era + 35 R2 + 16 R2-audit tests green unchanged

historical_note: The R2 adversarial audit record is preserved unmodified as historical evidence. Its consecutive-pair remedy language is superseded by this R3 invariant (COMPLETE_UNORDERED_PAIR_COVERAGE).
